etsy.title: Rink Coffee Sticker, Funny Hockey Parent Decal, Hockey Mom or Dad Gift, Early Ice Time Humor
etsy.description:
A rink coffee sticker for hockey parents who know exactly how long a cup stays hot in the stands: about four minutes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, notebook, planner, or the kitchen cabinet that holds the travel mugs. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Single hockey stickers appear at about $3 to $6, and many competitors advertise waterproof vinyl for bottles and cars, which this indoor sticker cannot match.
Hockey mom designs were the most common sticker results seen.

research.notes: Parent humor is well represented, and "rink life" is an indexed phrase. "rink coffee" itself was not seen as an indexed phrase, so it is a best guess that matches the printed text. Water bottle and mug wording is left out because this is indoor vinyl. Amazon was not searched. Evidence is from search results only, with no sales data.
